# template-engine-integration

> **MIXED: retained infrastructure and historical integration proposal.** The factory, host context and installed-template discovery exist; the session, catalog projection and constraint helpers described here were removed, and resolution and invocation are missing. Start with [Templates Architecture](../../README.md), not the future APIs in this directory. Phase 6 is proposed and unapproved.

Define the context-bound Microsoft.TemplateEngine integration layer for listing, resolving, and invoking installed templates.
